tagline: Cream paper card on charcoal with five pastel index tabs on the right edge, binder holes on the left, Bodoni Moda italics.

palette.description: cream page on charcoal, five pastel tabs mark the section

typography.style: classic high-contrast serif over a clean geometric sans

best_for: Material that is organised in sections and benefits from a physical-notebook feel: workshops, curricula, editorial reviews. The active tab tells the audience where they are.
avoid_for: Dark-room keynotes or decks with full-bleed imagery; the paper frame uses a lot of the canvas.
name: Notebook Tabs
